ref.description: The candidate's ref, or 'new' for an original premise
ref.title: Ref

universe.description: urban: a strange event intrudes on one ordinary city life (hook: what is happening?). emotional: an impossible offer, rule or what-if with a personal cost (hook: what would you do?). bedtime: gentle, warm, nature or sky, no threat
universe.title: Universe

story_type.description: fable: a short story whose message lives in its final image or choice, never stated. daily: a small magical moment in Fann's or Tina's ordinary day, fairytale aesthetics, no big cost or twist
story_type.title: Story Type

mode.description: Who speaks. narrated: the story is an event as a whole; only the narrator. dialogue: a small moment of characters interacting; only the characters. mixed: the narrator carries the story and characters speak their key lines
mode.title: Mode

lead.description: Who leads the episode: the lead given in <lead> (fann, tina, or both sharing the story). Bedtime fables too, with the lead as the storyteller or the one it happens to
lead.title: Lead

premise.description: One sentence: ordinary person + impossible element + stakes
premise.title: Premise

human_emotion.description: The feeling the story is really about (rule 1)
human_emotion.title: Human Emotion

magical_element.description: The impossible thing, and how it embodies or amplifies that emotion (rule 2)
magical_element.title: Magical Element

visual_anchor.description: The one object or place viewers will remember
visual_anchor.title: Visual Anchor

recurring.description: Recurring universe entities used, e.g. midnight_shop
recurring.title: Recurring

ending_image.description: The final image, choice or line, never a moral
ending_image.title: Ending Image

lingering_question.description: What the viewer is left thinking about afterwards (rule 7)
lingering_question.title: Lingering Question

connection.description: How this episode touches the shared world: a callback to an earlier episode, a trace of the other lead, or a step in Fann's lost-dreams thread. The episode must still make complete sense without it
connection.title: Connection

advances_dreams_thread.description: True if this episode moves Fann's lost-dreams storyline forward
advances_dreams_thread.title: Advances Dreams Thread

dreams_step.description: When advances_dreams_thread is true: the id of the step this episode tells, from dreams_thread (e.g. D3). Empty otherwise
dreams_step.title: Dreams Step

hook.description: Would a stranger stop scrolling at the first line? 0-10
hook.title: Hook

emotion.description: Is there a true, recognisable human feeling? 0-10
emotion.title: Emotion

visual.description: Does it have a memorable image or object? 0-10
visual.title: Visual

brand_fit.description: Does it obey the story bible's rules? 0-10
brand_fit.title: Brand Fit
